name: Orn Software Holding AS
summary: Orn Software Holding AS provides software as a service solutions for the industrial, facility, and property operations, maintenance, and management for various industries primarily in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Iceland. The company's products include ServiceBook, a solution to digitalize operations and facility inspections; Maintenance, a solution for industrial maintenance management; InControl, a system for internal control; Uni, a property and facility management solution for commercial and residential properties; Energy, an energy management system; Optima, a tool for operational decision-making; and Main Manager, a facility management system. It also provides solutions for real estate, manufacturing, food and beverage, and aquaculture industries, as well as for energy and environmental management systems. The company is headquartered in Trondheim, Norway.
